[size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size]
InstantShipping is a small, focused Stardew Valley mod that lets you ship items immediately — no walking to the shipping bin required. Press the configured key while hovering an item (or holding it on your cursor) and the mod will send it straight to your farm shipping bin. It supports shipping one, the whole stack, or a custom amount depending on your settings and modifier keys. Quick, simple, and saves you time hauling produce to the bin.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[b]Instant Shipping:[/b] Ships the hovered item or the item on your cursor directly to the farm shipping bin with one keypress.
[b]Multiple Modes:[/b] Configure default behavior: ship one, ship the whole stack, or ship a custom stack amount.
[b]Modifier Keys:[/b] Hold Shift to ship the whole stack, Ctrl to ship exactly one, or Alt to ship the custom amount.
[b]UI-aware:[/b] Works when hovering items in inventory pages and item menus (cursor item, player inventory, chests/ItemGrabMenu).
[b]Safety checks:[/b] Will warn if the item can’t be shipped (non-shippable items), and will not silently delete items.
[/list]


[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
You can choose if you should be able to ship the items from anywhere, or only if there is a Shipping Bin in the current location
You can change the max distance allowed for the above configuration
You can change how many items should go when you press the designed keybind, one, all of it, or a custom amount[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[list=1]

[b]Install SMAPI:[/b] Make sure you have the latest SMAPI installed.
[b]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (Recommended):[/b] For in-game configuration and keybinding.
[b]Download InstantShipping:[/b] Get the latest version from the Files tab of the mod page.
[b]Install InstantShipping:[/b] Unzip the download and place the [font=Courier New]InstantShipping[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.
[b]Launch the Game:[/b] Run Stardew Valley via SMAPI.[/list]
[size=5][b]Mod Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM):[/b] Fully supported for easy in-game configuration.
[/list]
